required_fields: ALL_FIELDS; unavailable and NO_SIGNAL conditions control nullability
nullable_fields: direction and magnitude fields for unavailable Outcome, provider error, or valid NO_SIGNAL
primary_endpoint_value for unavailable Outcome, provider error, or valid NO_SIGNAL
error_message unless status is UNAVAILABLE or INVALID
identity_rule: evaluation_id = EVL_<sha256(prediction_id, outcome_id, contract_version)[:20]>. It attaches exactly one Prediction to the canonical Outcome for that Prediction's Episode.

primary_endpoint.name: EPISODE_REACTION_DIRECTION_15M
primary_endpoint.definition: The predicted 15-minute Episode direction equals the canonical realized 15-minute direction under the shared 1-pip FLAT rule.

direction_scoring: UP, DOWN, and FLAT score true only on equality. UNCERTAIN is not a correct actionable directional forecast. Unavailable Outcomes and provider errors yield null, never false.
magnitude_rule: magnitude_15m_error is zero when abs(realized_pips_15m) lies in the inclusive predicted 15-minute [expected_pips_min, expected_pips_max] interval; otherwise it is distance to the nearest boundary.
reversal_rule: reversal_ok is equality of predicted and realized reversal_flag when both are available.
no_signal_rule: A valid no-signal scores true only when all four realized directions are FLAT and max(abs(max_up_pips), abs(max_down_pips)) < 1.0. It is otherwise false; it is not a free pass for an absent forecast.
complete_path_rule: overall_path_score is the unweighted mean of available 5/15/30/60 direction correctness values. Magnitude and reversal are separate supporting fields, not weighted into this v1 score.
intervening_event_rule: intervening_event_flag is report-only; it does not automatically exclude a row from v1 endpoints.
